decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the product feed to identify actual backpacks, excluding the camping gear, furniture, and food items that were loosely categorized. My consideration set includes a diverse range of functional backpacks: a technical hiking pack (Kailas), a tactical assault pack (W Wintming), a lightweight packable bag for travel (Zomake), a specialized hydration pack (Mubasel Gear), and a waterproof dry bag backpack (Piscifun). I ultimately chose the Kailas 28L Hiking Backpack because its reviews highlight a level of quality and design comparable to premium brands like Osprey, specifically mentioning the internal frame and suspension system which justify the slightly higher price point for a durable outdoor piece.
